reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off and limited headcount are exactly what I check first, and the free first visit lets me see it for myself at no risk. After that I'd probably only pay for the odd weekday visit, because the library storytime is free.
objection: $13 a visit for one toddler adds up fast on our budget, and I won't believe it's actually clean until I see it with my own eyes.
would_change_my_mind: A lower weekday price (around $8-9) or a pack that brings each visit under $10.
